title: Renewal Claims Load — LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy Rating Table
content:
**Table rule.** On a LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy renewal the claims load starts from the number of claims reported on the policy with a loss date in the tier's claims lookback (36 calendar months on every tier) up to the offer date: two or more such claims give 20 percent, exactly one gives 10 percent, and none gives 0 percent.

The claims load is a percentage added into the rating percentage by which the indicated renewal premium is increased after the inflation guard; that rating percentage is applied once.

| Claims reported on the policy with a loss date in the 36 calendar months up to the offer date | Claims load |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 20 percent |
| exactly 1 | 10 percent |
| none | 0 percent |

## What is counted

- Every claim reported on this policy counts, whatever its cause of loss and whether or not anything was paid on it.
- A claim falls in the window by its date of loss, measured back 36 calendar months from the offer date.

## Hypothetical claim files

| Claims on the policy | Claims load |
|---|---|
| loss dates 6 and 30 months before the offer date | 20 percent |
| loss dates 6 and 40 months before the offer date | 10 percent |
| one claim with a loss date 37 months before the offer date | 0 percent |
